```{r Load libraries}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(dplyr)
```


```{r Load genelist for upregulated}
gene_list <- c("list of genes identified")

gene_up <- bitr(gene_list,
                fromType = "SYMBOL",
                toType = "ENTREZID",
                OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

gene_up
```


```{r GO enrichment}
#GO Enrichment
ego <- enrichGO(
  gene          = gene_up$ENTREZID,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  ont           = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  readable      = TRUE
)

head(ego)

#Visualize
dotplot(ego, showCategory = 15)

ego_df <- as.data.frame(ego)

write.csv(ego_df, "/path_to_folder/sheet_name.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r KEGG analyses}
ekegg <- enrichKEGG(
  gene         = gene_up$ENTREZID,
  organism     = "hsa",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

dotplot(ekegg, showCategory = 15)

ekegg_df <- as.data.frame(ekegg)

write.csv(ekegg_df, "/path_to_folder/sheet_name.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
```{r Load genelist downregulated genes}
down_list <- c("list of genes identified")

gene_down <- bitr(down_list,
                fromType = "SYMBOL",
                toType = "ENTREZID",
                OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

gene_down
```

```{r GO enrichment}
#GO Enrichment
ego1 <- enrichGO(
  gene          = gene_down$ENTREZID,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  ont           = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  readable      = TRUE
)

head(ego1)

#Visualize
dotplot(ego1, showCategory = 15)

ego_df1 <- as.data.frame(ego1)

write.csv(ego_df1, "/path_to_folder/sheet_name.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r KEGG analyses}
ekegg1 <- enrichKEGG(
  gene         = gene_down$ENTREZID,
  organism     = "hsa",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

dotplot(ekegg1, showCategory = 15)

ekegg_df1 <- as.data.frame(ekegg1)

write.csv(ekegg_df1, "/path_to_folder/sheet_name.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
